summary.text: Sean Faircloth is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 24 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Faircloth won a February 2025 special election for District 24 and sits on the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Sean Faircloth earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Notre Dame.
He won a special general election for Maine House District 24 on February 25, 2025, defeating Carolyn Fish, and succeeded Joseph Perry.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignment as the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee.
Republican Daniel LaPointe is his 2026 general election opponent.
